description: Add an MCP server to the registry. New submissions are reviewed by a maintainer before they appear in search; get_server shows their status meanwhile. Fill in what you know from the server's README or package metadata. If the result is an error, fix the fields it names and call again. Never include secrets: env_vars takes variable names only, not values.

description.description: What the server does and anything it needs to run, in one or two sentences.

env_vars.description: Names of environment variables the server needs, e.g. WEATHER_API_KEY. Names only.

name.description: Unique name: a reverse-DNS namespace you can vouch for, a slash, and a short name. For a GitHub project use io.github.<owner>/<repo>, e.g. io.github.acme/weather-mcp. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

package_identifier.description: Required for stdio: the package name or image, e.g. @acme/weather-mcp or ghcr.io/acme/weather-mcp.

package_registry.description: Required for stdio: where the package is published.

remote_url.description: Required for streamable-http and sse: the URL clients connect to.

tags.description: Lowercase topic tags, e.g. weather, data.

tools.description: Names of the tools the server exposes.

transport.description: stdio for a server run locally from a package; streamable-http for a hosted server reached by URL; sse only for older hosted servers.

name: submit_server
title: Submit an MCP server
